description: Defines classes CRunContainer and CRunContainerAdministrator for managing container instances, including methods for starting, stopping, and retrieving container info, within the Thunder::ProcessContainers namespace.

classes.name: CRunContainer
classes.description: Represents a container with methods to start, stop, and retrieve info, managing container lifecycle and synchronization.

classes.name: CRunContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing container instances, providing container creation and logging functionalities.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container.

methods.name: CRunContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container with a timeout.

methods.name: CRunContainerAdministrator::Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container instance based on ID and search paths.
